need.purpose_or_required_outcome: Use an external MCP server that exposes resources and tools while preserving Catalyst responsibility and Capability identity boundaries.

responsibilities: connect to an interoperable external tool/context surface
map only proven organizational responsibilities into Catalyst Capability identities

solution.mechanism_or_implementation_candidate: MCP adapter at the interoperability boundary
solution.short_rationale: MCP provides transport/control primitives. A tool name or resource URI is not automatically a Catalyst semantic Capability.

evidence_requirements: no automatic Capability id is minted per MCP tool
MCP implementation can be replaced without redefining Catalyst public WHAT

governance.stop_condition: Stop at the adapter boundary unless a real cross-system semantic gap is observed.
